environment.description: Terraform provider deployed in AWS EC2 with IMDSv1 enabled. LaunchDarkly project 'infra-providers' has flag 'enable-direct-metadata-fetch' targeting rule: 'terraform-provider-internal' user returns TRUE. No network egress restrictions on the instance. Provider is invoked via CI/CD pipeline running terraform apply with user-supplied .tf files.

config.network: no egress filtering, full internal network access
